clustersMultipeak.map: zmap_2mm + MULTIPEAK_BLOBS inside the brain (add ≥ 0.05, float32)
clustersMultipeak.rule: |z| > 3.1, both signs, 26-connected, ≤ 3 peaks per cluster ≥ 8 mm apart

rft.method: SPM spm_P_RF, z field, D = 3; p(FWE) over both tails (sign both): 1 − (1 − p_tail)^2

multirun.block: 3x3x3 voxels around voxelIjk carry each run course; the rest of the brain ellipsoid is baseline + texture (time-constant); zero outside

runs.label: run-1
runs.courseFormula: 100 + 10 * exp(-((t - 5) / 2)^2), t = 0-based frame in the run

runs.label: run-2
runs.courseFormula: 102 + 20 * exp(-((t - 12) / 2)^2), t = 0-based frame in the run

runs.label: run-3
runs.courseFormula: 98 + 15 * exp(-((t - 9) / 2)^2), t = 0-based frame in the run

multirun.percentiles: nearest-rank over every non-zero voxel of every frame of the run
